newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Baan Co started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Baan Co started as buy.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said on Tuesday it had started coverage of Dutch software maker Baan Co NV with a buy rating.
-- The firm also placed Baan on its recommended list of stocks.

-- The company's market in enterprise resource planning applications software is expected to grow at a compounded annual rate of 41.7 percent, to $18.6 billion in 2000, analysts Sanjiv Hingorani and Sheela Chandrasekhara wrote in a report.

-- Among other reasons for the rating, the analysts wrote that Baan's software is easy to use, its products are global in nature and the company has continued to acquire technologies, companies and products.
-- The company's stock was up 5/16 to 35-13/16 in New York trading.
